purpose: Automated detection, triage, evidence gathering, risk assessment, and explanation for financial crime cases (fraud and AML). Classified as high-risk AI under EU AI Act Annex III.

training_data_sources.name: AMLSim synthetic transaction simulator
training_data_sources.notes: SSN field hashed SHA-256[:12] before storage. See data/ingestion/load_external.py.

models.name: EvolveGCN temporal graph model
models.known_limitations: Current implementation is a frequency-count heuristic, not a trained model output.

human_oversight_mechanisms: HITL gate on Calling Agent: AI never calls a customer directly. Investigator must explicitly approve.
Verification Agent: independent second pass that can override any earlier agent conclusion.
HOLD_FOR_VERIFICATION path: pre-transaction decisions reviewable before becoming permanent.
ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN_REVIEW: any case with severity >= 8 or NOVEL_PATTERN is mandatorily human-reviewed.
QA Agent: post-hoc human auditor review of closed cases.

conformity_assessment.notes: Formal conformity assessment required before EU deployment per EU AI Act Article 43.
